description: A warrior with a large feathered headdress and a spear stands in the foreground, with a column of spear-carrying warriors behind him holding round and rectangular shields with painted faces. Behind them rise red and white stepped pyramids with stairways in a jungle setting, with smoke and torches in the air. On the right, townspeople in cloth and feathers watch, some holding small fires. No text, numbers or frame are visible, and the painting fills the image edge to edge.
